name: Polls CP
author: codepeople

sections.description:
Polls CP features:

  • Classic one-click radio-button polls
  • Advanced polls with dependant questions
  • Built-in GDPR & Privacy controls (salted IP hashing, configurable cookie duration, data retention, WordPress Privacy Tools integration)
  • Export results to Excel / CSV (UTF-8 with formula-injection protection)
  • Printable list of votes
  • Visual drag and drop form builder
  • Stateless anti-spam captcha (no PHP sessions or tracking cookies)
  • Field validation
  • Graphic reports
  • Printable reports
  • Email notifications
  • Automatic scheduled email reports (via WP-Cron)

With Polls CP you can publish a poll into a page/post and optionally display statistics of the results. You can receive email notifications every time a vote is added or opt to receive CSV/Excel reports periodically.

The Polls can have dependant questions, meaning some questions are displayed depending on the selection made on other questions.

Privacy & GDPR Features:

  • Privacy-first IP handling: Choose between salted HMAC-SHA256 hashing (allows one-vote-per-IP limits without storing personal IP addresses), IP anonymization, no IP storage, or full IP storage — globally or per poll.
  • Smart vote-limit cookies: Functional vote-limit cookies are only set when cookie-based limiting is enabled, use configurable expiration lifetimes, and include HttpOnly, SameSite=Lax, and Secure (HTTPS) flags.
  • WordPress Core Privacy Tools: Full support for Tools -> Export Personal Data, Tools -> Erase Personal Data (with anonymization that keeps poll counts intact), and Settings -> Privacy -> Policy Guide.
  • Automatic Data Retention: Daily WP-Cron cleanup to automatically anonymize PII or delete old submissions after a configurable number of days.
  • Optional GDPR Consent Checkbox: Require explicit consent with an automatic link to your WordPress Privacy Policy page.
  • No external CDN calls: All admin and public assets are loaded locally.

More about the Main Features:

  • Votes can be limited to one per user: Poll votes can be limited to one per user based on cookies or privacy-safe IP verification, or set to accept unlimited votes.
  • Interactive questions: Questions can be shown or hidden depending on the selection made on previous questions.
  • All languages supported: Visually configurable/editable for any language.
  • Email delivery / notifications: Poll votes can be emailed to one or more email addresses.
  • Poll votes saved into the database: Keep a record of received poll votes, generate statistics, and export data.
  • Printable list of votes & Bulk GDPR tools: Filter, print, delete, or bulk-anonymize votes from the Votes screen.
  • Export data to CSV/Excel: Export poll data to UTF-8 CSV files with spreadsheet formula protection and optional PII exclusion.
  • Automatic email reports: Scheduled via WP-Cron with secure temporary CSV attachments deleted immediately after delivery.
sections.installation:
To install Polls CP, follow these steps:

  1. Download and unzip the Polls CP plugin
  2. Upload the entire cp-polls/ directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the Polls CP plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  4. Configure poll and GDPR settings at Settings -> Polls CP
  5. Insert a poll into any page or post using the CP Polls Gutenberg block or [CP_POLLS id="1"] shortcode
sections.faq:
Where do I report security bugs found in this plugin?

Please report security bugs found in the source code of the CP Polls plugin through the Patchstack Vulnerability Disclosure Program. The Patchstack team will assist you with verification, CVE assignment, and notify the developers of this plugin.

Q: How can I display the poll results in a separate page?

A: You can use the following shortcode to display the poll results:

[CP_POLLS id="1" results="1"]

The first attribute is the ID of the poll form and results="1" shows only the results.

Q: How does CP Polls handle GDPR and voter IP addresses?

A: By default, CP Polls uses Salted Hash mode, which stores an irreversible per-poll HMAC-SHA256 digest instead of the visitor’s IP address. This lets you enforce one-vote-per-IP limits without storing personal IP data. You can customize IP handling, cookie duration, data retention, CSV PII inclusion, and consent checkboxes globally under Settings -> Polls CP or per poll.

Q: How can I add specific fields into the email notification?

A: Use <%INFO%> for all submitted information or specific field tags such as <%fieldname1%>, <%fieldname2%>, etc.

Q: How can I disable sending email notifications on every vote?

A: Leave the “Destination emails” settings field empty to disable notifications after each vote.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Modernized Admin Interface: Redesigned dashboard, poll editor, votes list, reports, and custom CSS editor with a clean tabbed layout and quick shortcode copying.
  • Improved Form Builder: Rebuilt drag-and-drop question and choice ordering with live visual preview and smoother editing.
  • New GDPR & Privacy Options: Added global and per-poll IP handling (salted hash, anonymized, or disabled), configurable vote-limit cookie duration, optional consent checkbox with Privacy Policy link, automatic data retention, bulk vote anonymization, and integration with WordPress Personal Data Export/Erasure tools.
  • Refreshed Public Poll & Captcha: Updated public voting form and results styling, improved validation message alignment, and refreshed the anti-spam captcha appearance with an inline refresh button.
  • Performance & Compatibility: Consolidated scripts into bundled static JavaScript files to reduce HTTP requests, updated Gutenberg block to Block API v3, improved PHP 8+ and WordPress 7.x compatibility, and applied general code hardening and stability improvements.
